name: Document Reader
description: Universal document reader with TTS. Fullscreen reading mode, visual PDF canvas rendering, text selection reading, word-by-word highlighting, audiobook-style controls.
author: Hecos Team / Antonio Meloni

commands.read_document: Open a document in the fullscreen reader with TTS capabilities. Accepts filename, partial name (e.g. 'fotoromanzo'), or full path.
commands.stop_reading: Stop the current TTS reading session.
commands.list_documents: List all readable documents (PDF, TXT, MD, HTML, DOCX) available in the documents library.

slash_commands.description: Apre e legge un documento con voce sintetizzata nel Document Reader
Interrompe la lettura vocale attiva nel Document Reader
Elenca i documenti disponibili da leggere con il Document Reader

function.name: DOCUMENT_READER__read_document
function.description: Open a PDF or text document in the fullscreen reader with text-to-speech capabilities. Resolves filenames and partial keywords (e.g. 'fotoromanzo', 'fotoromanzo numero 1') automatically from the documents folder.

path.description: File path, filename, or document search query (e.g. 'fotoromanzo', 'fotoromanzo numero 1'). If omitted, lists available documents.

function.name: DOCUMENT_READER__stop_reading
function.description: Stop the current text-to-speech reading session.

function.name: DOCUMENT_READER__list_documents
function.description: List all readable documents (PDF, TXT, MD, HTML, DOCX) available in the documents library.

folder.description: Optional directory path to inspect. Defaults to standard documents library (modules/media/documents).

capabilities.syscall_notes: Autonomous document reader with TTS: provides read_document, stop_reading, and list_documents with smart path and partial name resolution.
capabilities.notes: Visual PDF canvas rendering with images/illustrations, Dual TTS (Local Hecos Piper/ElevenLabs and Browser Web Speech), full keyboard shortcuts, and ESC voice-stop priority.

tts_engine.description: TTS Engine: 'browser' (Web Speech API) or 'local' (Hecos Local TTS).

default_voice.description: Preferred Web Speech API voice name.
